simple.meaning: לִשְׁכָּה (lishkâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 48 times across 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, and 3 more, beginning at 1 Samuel 9:22. Its contexts include family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לִשְׁכָּה (H3957).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: לִשְׁכָּה (lishkâh) / H3957 is traced through 1 Samuel 9:22, 2 Kings 23:11, 1 Chronicles 9:26, 1 Chronicles 9:33 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging)
definitions.full: H3957. lishkah לִשְׁכָּה noun feminine room, chamber, hall, cell, lishka (Late Hebrew id. לִשְׁכְּתָא ᵑ7 ; compare also נִשְׁכָּה ; on the lishka see Now Archaeology ii. 37, 52, 79 ; Bo Geogr.I, xvii. 438 (ed. Leusd.) compare Greek λέσχη , compare Rs Semitic i. 236 (2nd ed. 254) and elsewhere ); — ׳ל Ezek 40:38 +; construct לִשְׁכַּת 2Kin 23:11 +; with ה locative לִשְׁכָּ֑תָה 1Sam 9:22 ; plural לְשָׁכוֺת Ezek 40:17 +; construct לִשְׁכוֺת Neh 10:38 +; — 1. a. of room connected with a sanctuary ( בָּמָה ), where sacrificial meal was eaten 1Sam 9:22 , insert also probably 1:18 ( ᵐ5 We Dr Klo Bu). b. connected with Solomon's temple, where wine offered to Rechabites Jer 35:2 , 4 ; compare 35:4 ; 35:4 one where prophecy read 36:10 (both these apparently open, compare Gie 35:2 ); compare בַּמַּרְוָרִים ֗֗֗ הַסָּרִיס נְתַןמֶֿלֶךְ לִשְׁכַּת 2Kin 23:11 ; used of Levites' cells 1Chr 9:33 ; = store-rooms 9:26 (|| אֹצָרוֺת ), 23:28 ; 28:12 ; 2Chr 31:11 . c. in Ezekiel's temple , cells for priests, singers, etc. Ezek 40:17 (twice in verse); 40:38 , 44 , 45 , 46 + 41:10 (strike out Co Bthl), 42:1 , 4 , 7 , 8 , 11 + 42:12 (strike out Co Bthl); in three tiers, compare ׳הַלְּ הָעֶלְיוֺנֹת 42:5 (see 42:3 ), ( 45:5 read ᵐ5 לָשֶׁבֶת עָרִים Sm Co Sgfr KauAT Bthl ); ׳ל הַקֹּדֶשׁ for sacred uses 42:13 (3 t. in verse); 44:19 ; 46:19 . d. in second temple, as store-rooms Ezra 8:29 ; Neh 10:38 ; 10:39 (|| הָאוֺצָר בֵּית ), Nehemiah 10:40; used by individuals Ezra 10:6 ; Neh 13:5 ( ׳ל גְּדוֺלָה ), 13:8 , in General 13:4 ; 13:9 . 2 of scribe's room in royal palace Jer 36:12 , 20 , 21 .
